rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00000.text: $$サイデリアル$$ Base: Command Room
notes: Location banner, no speaker line; sha matches the STGZ3REN_00045 hangar/command-room banner pattern (see story_0014).

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00001.text: $$サイデリアル$$ Base: Command Room

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00002.text: $$サイデリアル$$ Base: Command Room

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00003.text: ~$$ターミナル・ベース$$: Command Room~
notes: pid_MUZIN in-fiction display banner, treated as plain text per STGZ3REN_00045:00026 precedent; kept 'Terminal Base' unwrapped, matching that batch.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00005.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「What is it, $$クロウ$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00006.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Why are you so interested in the $$スフィア$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00007.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Because it's wonderful, isn't it?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00009.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「$$次元力$$, which governs every phenomenon...
　And the $$スフィア$$ is the organ that draws it out...」
notes: 次元力 and レイライン used per established prior-slice convention (proposed glossary status, used as-is; レイライン rendered lowercase |lc as in story_0013/0014).

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00010.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「In other words, if you can master the $$スフィア$$,
　everything goes exactly as you wish」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00011.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ho-ho...
　So then, the reason $$サイデリアル$$ draws out
　this Earth's $$次元力$$ through the $$レイライン|lc$$ is also...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00012.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I think that boundless energy isn't just
　used for weapons like the $$次元転移砲$$ -
　ultimately, the goal is to control phenomena itself」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00013.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「After all, this planet sits in just the right
　position for drawing out $$次元力$$ -
　energy that a star itself holds」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00014.text:
$$ランド$$
「Even so, mess it up
　and the Earth itself'll get wrecked」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00015.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「And even converting that energy into weapons,
　this is still just a star out on the galaxy's frontier...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00016.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Using this planet's power for the struggle
　over hegemony at the galactic core
　strikes me as terribly inefficient, though」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00017.text:
$$クロウ$$
「What's this "struggle for hegemony at the galactic core" thing?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00018.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh my, you don't know?
　Well, I suppose that's only natural
　for folks living out on the frontier」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00019.text:
$$ランド$$
「Sorry for bein' a space bumpkin」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00020.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「No, no.
　Being a bumpkin, a big eater, sweaty, and
　smelly-footed to boot - what's wrong with that?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00021.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait a minute!
　That's not a trait of Earthlings -
　that's just $$ランド$$'s trait!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00022.text:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm... careful about
　deodorizing my boots, at least」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00023.text:
$$オリオン$$
「...True enough.
　$$セツコ$$ always smells nice」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00025.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then allow me as well to share
　in that lovely fragrance...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00027.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Ahaha... this looks hopeless」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00028.text:
$$ランド$$
「So, old man.
　Let's hear the rest of that story
　about the hegemony struggle at the galactic core」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00029.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, since I'm what you'd call
　a bumpkin too, I don't know much myself, but...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00030.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「At the galactic core, I hear,
　people from all sorts of star systems
　keep fighting one another over hegemony」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00031.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Hegemony... like some kind of territorial dispute?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00032.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... the galaxy's a vast place, after all.
　I don't think struggles over territory
　get quite that severe, but...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00033.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Still, some of these conflicts have dragged on
　for centuries, and seem to carry
　all sorts of complicated history behind them」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00034.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「That's why $$サイデリアル$$'s main force
　is active at the galactic core as well」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00035.text:
$$クロウ$$
「For a self-proclaimed bumpkin,
　you sure know a lot」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00036.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Believe it or not, I used to be
　a man of scholarship」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00037.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Faint, but I can definitely catch
　a whiff of intellect off you...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00038.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Haha... that's ancient history now, though」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00039.text:
$$セツコ$$
「The galaxy too is full of fighting...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00040.text:
$$ランド$$
「Rough life, that.
　I'm fine bein' a bumpkin - livin' easy
　here on Earth suits me a lot better」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00041.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Oh, come on...!
　Not you, with a nickname like that, $$ランド$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00042.text:
$$クロウ$$
「$$クラヴィア$$!
　You're from a planet other than Earth too, aren't you!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00045.text:
$$クロウ$$
「What do you think, $$クラヴィア$$?
　It might be the frontier, but Earth's
　not such a bad planet, is it」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00046.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Yes...
　Because here, something that's been lost
　on so many stars across the galaxy still remains」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00047.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes.
　I believe that's exactly this planet's treasure,
　myself」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00048.text:
$$セツコ$$
「And that lost thing would be...?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00051.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I can't explain it well, but things like
　emotion, the will to live, vitality itself -
　they all feel weaker compared to this planet」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00052.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「For example, many other planets surrendered
　far more readily to $$サイデリアル$$'s invasion,
　and accepted its rule」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00053.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「A $$レジスタンス$$ that keeps fighting back
　the way it does on this planet
　is a rare case indeed」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00055.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I think that's also the reason
　$$スフィア$$s gather on this planet」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00056.text:
$$セツコ$$
「It's true the $$スフィア$$ seems to respond
　to the stirrings of people's hearts
　and emotions, but...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00057.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Earlier, $$サルディアス$$ said that using
　Earth's $$次元力$$ for the galaxy's hegemony
　struggle was inefficient, but...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00058.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「If it's a $$スフィア$$ that can draw out
　$$次元力$$ regardless of location,
　that problem would be solved too」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00060.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I'm sure it would also be possible
　to freely draw on, using the $$スフィア$$'s power,
　the $$次元力$$ extracted here on Earth」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00061.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Building a system to draw out
　Earth's $$次元力$$...
　That's why $$サイデリアル$$ wants the $$スフィア$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00062.text:
$$クロウ$$
「But I'm surprised they'd already got
　data on me, $$セツコ$$, and $$ランド$$ too」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00063.text:
$$ランド$$
「But how'd those guys
　find out about us, anyway?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00064.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「That much, even I don't know」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00067.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Us... from the first time we met,
　we could somehow tell the other one
　was a $$リアクター$$, right...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00069.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Same for me.
　I can't explain it well, but there was
　somehow something that connected us...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00070.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Speaking of that, in 《$$前の戦い$$》
　I fought two $$リアクター$$s」
notes: 前の戦い is not a glossary key; kept as keyword link with English label 'the previous battle', recorded in link_labels.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00071.text:
$$セツコ$$
「That's 《$$アイム$$》 $$ライアード$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$,
　and 《$$ユーサー$$》 $$インサラウム$$ of
　the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, isn't it?」
notes: New term 尽きぬ水瓶 = Bottomless Gourd (Aquarius Sphere); 偽りの黒羊 reused as glossary key.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00072.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Even before I awakened as a $$リアクター$$,
　$$アイム$$ had already marked my existence...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00073.text:
$$クロウ$$
「At the same time, I sensed something
　about $$ユーサー$$ even before he awakened...」
notes: Gender 'he' for Uther based on wiki description 'Holy King of Insaraum', not inferred from name.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00074.text:
$$ランド$$
「Are you saying a $$リアクター$$ whose
　awakening has progressed further can
　sense one who hasn't awakened yet?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00076.text:
$$ランド$$
「Then, if $$サイデリアル$$ sensed
　our existence, that means...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00077.text:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ already has a $$リアクター$$ of its own...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00078.text:
$$クロウ$$
「They know about $$スフィア$$s, and they've
　even got a research team on it...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00079.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Of course, they've probably got at least one of the real things too」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00080.text:
$$セツコ$$
「What do you think, $$クラヴィア$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00081.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I-I don't know for certain, but I
　think $$クロウ$$'s guess is right」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00082.text:
$$ランド$$
「A $$サイデリアル$$ $$リアクター$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00083.text:
$$クロウ$$
「And that one might be even better at
　wielding $$スフィア$$ power than we are...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00084.text:
$$セツコ$$
（A higher $$リアクター$$ that can sense other
　$$リアクター$$s... Could it be that's how
　$$アドヴェント$$ was able to find us...）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00088.text:
$$ブルー$$
「Yes! The $$レジスタンス$$ members on watch
　duty are moving to intercept, but...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00089.text:
$$ブルー$$
「Just in case, please prepare to sortie as well!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00090.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh no, looks like they've come to take the base back already」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00091.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「But I checked our radar too, and it
　looks like there's only one enemy unit」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00096.text:
$$クロウ$$
「This is bad, $$ブルー$$...
　This might turn into something seriously
　messed up...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00104.text:
$$クロウ$$
「This time the gap in power's so huge,
　I can't even feel angry about it...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00105.text:
$$セツコ$$
「How are the $$レジスタンス$$ members doing?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00106.text:
$$ブルー$$
「They were ambushed by $$サイデリアル$$
　forces waiting for them after they
　pulled back, and got scattered」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00107.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Haha... They didn't wreck the base
　when they abandoned it because they
　knew they'd take it right back, haha...」
notes: Compressed to 4 lines total; kept full meaning (didn't destroy facilities because confident of retaking base).

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00108.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...As you can see. The $$沈黙の巨蟹$$
　$$リアクター$$, $$尸空$$... His power
　far exceeds anything we imagined」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00109.text:
$$ランド$$
「And that guy's a member of $$サイデリアル$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00110.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Maybe he's not the only one...
　$$サイデリアル$$ might have more
　monsters like that...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00113.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I... I was so focused on what $$スフィア$$s
　could do that I barely thought about
　how they'd actually be used」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00114.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「But... today, for the first time, I
　learned just how terrifying that
　power really is...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00115.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right. But if wielded by the
　right person, that power can also
　break through wickedness like that」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00116.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「...But in the end, I wasn't able to
　break into the base's database」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00117.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, this is a problem...
　And here we'd need a $$スフィア$$ of our
　own to beat that zombie crab...」
notes: ゾンビガニ (informal insult referring to Shikuu/Taciturn Crab) translated literally as 'zombie crab'; not glossarized as a separate term.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00118.text:
$$ブルー$$
「If we don't have that information...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00120.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't worry about it, $$クラヴィア$$.
　You did everything you could」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00121.text:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah, yeah. Even without a $$スフィア$$,
　we can still take that bastard down」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00122.text:
$$セツコ$$
「So let's give it our best. You too,
　$$クラヴィア$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00125.text:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, you...
　Don't go raining on the moment when
　we're finally getting fired up」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00126.text:
$$オリオン$$
「In other words, all you need is a
　machine equipped with that $$スフィア$$
　thing, right?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00127.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't say it like it's that easy.
　We were just saying we've got no
　lead on one」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00128.text:
$$セツコ$$
「$$オリオン$$...
　Do you know something?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00129.text:
$$オリオン$$
「Breaking through a protection that flimsy is nothing」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00131.text:
$$オリオン$$
「I already pulled the data on where
　the $$スフィア$$-equipped unit is being
　analyzed」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00133.text:
$$クロウ$$
「So...!
　You found out where the unit is!?」

notes: New term ハマリエル = Hamaliel (codename), confirmed via wiki story summary; kept 『』 wrapper.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00051:00135.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The name of the Virgin House's
　guardian angel... Meaning, it's
　Virgo」
notes: 処女宮 (Virgin's House/Palace, astrological) vs 乙女座 (Virgo, the constellation) are two different JP words for the same target; rendered as 'Virgin House' vs 'Virgo' to preserve the distinction Advent is drawing.
